samples.reason: Curlew substantially outperforms Willet on instruction following (IFEval 90.4 vs 85.3), scientific reasoning (GPQA Diamond 62.5 vs 56.2), and support dialogue (86.2 vs 78.9), all of which are relevant to this physics career question requiring structured but candid explanatory detail.

Curlew outperforms Willet on the relevant technical benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, GPQA Diamond) and on the internal evals closest to this task type (Support Dialogue, Summarization, and Creative Generation), making it the stronger choice for producing a detailed, informed career breakdown.

Both models rate Creative Generation equally, but Curlew outperforms Willet meaningfully on the relevant internal routing dimensions.
